decisions.guard_extension: precondition: scheduler attachment must initialize the optimizer param-group lr to the scheduler's step-0 value (warmup_min_lr) at construction
decisions.note: value_scaling_consistency re-resolved to config_effectiveness per the D-NEW-8 precedent; independent of D-NEW-8's hard-coded peak-LR defect.
Evidently the same pre-LN residual-clobber incident as T23 supports B13/O-002 (near-verbatim issue text, no independent fix evidence); counts once per §4.1.
Bounded object (attention mask bias / attention-output finiteness under autocast) matches no existing bounded template or singleton per §3.2.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: CPU Adam/Adagrad kernels must step numel() elements of ndim>=2 params, not size(0)
decisions.note: count_frequency_match re-resolved to update_effectiveness; partial kernel extent leaves elements un-updated despite nonzero grads (T22 D-006 analog).

Promoted with independent singleton OC-NEW-65: same boundedness relation over supervision label indices vs the valid target index range; differences guard-expressible (§2), two independent incidents (§4).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: z-loss under reduction='mean' must be the scalar masked mean over non-ignore_index tokens; topology guard: single-rank
decisions.note: Masked-mean normalization defect on a loss component; independent of B15 (different function and fix).
Inverted outlier skip gate; the trigger object is a statistical outlier flag, not T21's gradient-overflow event, so not T21 plus guards (§2.2, §3.3).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: HSDP grad-norm reductions must span the shard process group (explicit process_group), not WORLD
decisions.note: Independent of the O-NEW-31/O-NEW-32 replica-divisor incident (different fix).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: FP4 DelayedScaling with CUDA graphs must save/restore per-module recipe state around each replay to match the eager reference
decisions.note: invariance_across_config aliases to reference_equivalence; witness is a paired eager-vs-replay run of the same code (T03, not T24's within-step self-comparison).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: MoE GroupedGEMM with TP>1, sequence_parallel=False, EP=1 must gather expert tokens across TP ranks so outputs match the TP=1 reference
decisions.note: Output invariance to TP degree, a performance-only knob.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: config-DSL recipe path must materialize parameters in the configured mixed-precision dtype (params_dtype derived from mixed_precision_dtype)
decisions.note: Designated-dtype fidelity at init, following the zero.Init target-dtype precedent.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: extra-large param reduction under bf16 + grad_accum_dtype=fp32 + ZeRO-1 CPU offload must consume the accumulated fp32 buffer, not raw bf16 param.grad
decisions.note: Reduced gradient must be the accumulated designated buffer (T07 designated-destination clause).

decisions.guard_extension: topology guard: DP>1 and CP>1; precondition: gradient scaling divisor must equal dp_size*cp_size, the span of the reduction collective
decisions.note: Directly instantiates T08's cp_size term in spec_scale.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: Megatron-FSDP gradient_accumulation_fusion must reconstruct the live main_grad (get_main_grad) each iteration
decisions.note: Stale accumulation buffer breaks the sum-of-microbatch-contributions invariant.
Evidently the same ZeRO CPU-offload copy-vs-accumulate micro_step_id incident already recorded verbatim in T07's preconditions; counts once per §4.1.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: evaluator loader position counters must reset to zero at each eval-pass start under eval_duration truncation (reset(), not only reshuffle())
decisions.note: Loader bookkeeping reset at a run boundary; different repo than seed support O-019, counts independently.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: as_tensor conversion must preserve the floating-point dtype of non-bool numpy arrays (soft-label probabilities not truncated to int); phase: data_loading
decisions.note: Input tensor must retain its declared dtype at the point of use.
Evidently the same LinearWithFrozenWeight missing-TP-all-reduce incident as T01 support B2 (precondition records the defect verbatim); counts once per §4.1.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: mrope under CP>1 must slice along the sequence axis with the correct cp_group so each rank's rotary positions match its own sequence partition
decisions.note: invariance_across_config re-resolved to index_consistency per the OC-NEW-12 precedent.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: softmax_auxiliary_loss z-loss must be normalized by batch_size_in_tokens, not num_micro_batches
decisions.note: Wrong normalization divisor on an auxiliary loss; independent of B14 (different function and fix).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: each multi-granularity loss component must be divided by the position count of its own granularity (byte vs patch positions)
decisions.note: Independent of T08 support OC-NEW-56 (wrong-granularity denominator vs missing finalize).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: fused-ops backward_dw wgrad hooks must fire on the parameter-owning modules so param.grad is cleared and each expert wgrad enters main_grad exactly once
decisions.note: Double-counted contribution violates T07's added-exactly-once clause; independent of T26 support M-NEW-56 (missing invocation, different defect).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: fp32 residual through bias-dropout-add must retain fp32 (upcast the compute branch to the residual dtype, never downcast the residual)
decisions.note: Residual stream dtype fidelity at the point of use.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: isinstance-ordered init dispatch must reach the subclass branch (subclass before parent) so subclass-specific projections receive their designated init
decisions.note: structural_integrity re-resolved to value_scaling_consistency; uninitialized-memory weights are T27's never-uninitialized clause.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: multi-param-group backward hooks must bind each parameter's own group index (no late-bound closure) so gradients route to the owning group's reduction bucket
decisions.note: structural_integrity re-resolved to conservation; wrong-bucket routing violates T07's designated-destination clause.
